introHtml: Polyester wine carriers combine durability with a soft, fabric feel that resists scuffs and stains better than canvas or nylon. The Rendezvous Wine & Food Caddy, for example, features insulated compartments that keep bottles stable during transit. For bulk buyers, polyester offers a cost-effective material that accepts full-color screen printing or embroidery, making it ideal for branded corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or client appreciation packages.
